title: William, Archbishop of Tyre
summary: Raleigh names William, Archbishop of Tyre in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). William, Archbishop of Tyre, who flourished about the yeere of our Lord 1180. That is not a yeere of the World. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

birth.date: William, Archbishop of Tyre, who flourished about the yeere of our Lord, one thousand one hundred eightie
birth.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book II, Part I, Chapter II, §. III, sig. 169a–169b
birth.note: Body intake. The yeere of our Lord in which he says William flourished. Not a yeere of the World, and not a birth year. year_bc_ad stays null. This does not change the sort.
